jon: prefer env var pattern (REDWOOD_REGION) for examples. add one sentence about latency vs residency tradeoff.

sam-legal: copy note  avoid absolutes like 'data never leaves region'. use: 'For Hosted plans, customer content is processed and stored in the selected region where available. For Dedicated and Private deployments, residency is available via contract (see DPA: https://redwood.example.com/dpa). Some operational metadata (telemetry, backups) may be processed outside the selected region; see the DPA.'

eng-runtime: confirm: regional domains api.<region>.redwood.ai supported. X-Redwood-Region header kept for backward compatibility. KV cache is cluster-local; Dedicated/Private are region-local unless replication requested. Hosted may read from another region for availability failover. OK to land.
